name: AfterLongTime

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving into a first home after years of renting

setting.relationship_dynamic: First-time homeowners preparing to leave a rental
setting.background: They have purchased their first home and need to move while also dealing with repairs, utilities, and unfinished work at the property
setting.conversation_style: Excited planning mixed with uncertainty about responsibilities they have not encountered before

scenario_template.note: They celebrate getting their first home and discuss the moving date
They realize that painting, cleaning, minor repairs, and utility setup overlap with moving tasks

scenario_template.topic: The house is not fully ready
scenario_template.note: They discover that some planned work will not be completed before the moving date
They ask the Assistant to distinguish between tasks that need to happen before moving in and tasks that can wait

scenario_template.topic: Setting up essential utilities and rooms
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them focus on basic functionality rather than making the entire house perfect immediately

scenario_template.topic: Moving boxes arrive before the house is ready
scenario_template.note: They need to decide where to place belongings while some rooms are still being worked on
They create a practical order for unpacking, cleaning, furnishing, and completing remaining work
They recognize that the house does not need to be perfect immediately and celebrate finally having their own home

scenario_template.topic: Furniture arrangement in the new space
scenario_template.note: They gently argue over the best place for the couch in the new living room.
User2 enthusiastically shares ideas about garden layout and interior decorations.

scenario_template.topic: Trip to a home improvement store
scenario_template.note: They plan a visit to buy paints and other supplies, imagining how the new colors will transform their space.
A neighbor drops by to introduce themselves, leading to a quick chat about the neighborhood.
They reflect on the newfound responsibilities of homeownership, acknowledging the challenges.
They take a break from unpacking to enjoy some pizza, enjoying the moment.
They discuss reallocating funds to cover unforeseen repair costs and consider future savings plans.
User2 mentions discovering a charming cafe nearby, prompting user1 to suggest visiting the local park.
They troubleshoot problems with setting up their internet connection, discussing possible solutions.
They brainstorm ideas for a fun housewarming party and who to invite.
They recognize that the house does not need to be perfect immediately and celebrate finally having their own home

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
